description: Check a GitHub repo's current test coverage and what it takes to reach 80%. Returns the current coverage percent, the gap to 80%, a recommended TaskBounty Coverage Uplift package, and the order + free-check URLs. No login required. Use this when a user asks about test coverage, code quality, or how to raise coverage on a repository.

repo.description: GitHub repo as a URL (https://github.com/owner/name) or owner/name.

name: check_coverage
